fee_refund_policy.photo_condition: If the Crown rejects Fabsy's efforts to reduce the original fine or obtain a withdrawal of your photo radar or red-light camera notice, and neither improvement is obtained, Fabsy refunds your service fee within 30 days of receiving the rejection.
